faqs.heading: Frequently Asked Questions Before
faqs.subheading: We believe in complete transparency. Here are honest answers to the common questions clients ask us before signing a proposal.

items.question: How much does a website, custom mobile app, or retail POS system cost?
items.answer: Costs depend on scope and feature complexity. A high-speed corporate business website typically ranges between PKR 45,000 to PKR 150,000. Custom POS desktop software ranges between PKR 60,000 to PKR 250,000 depending on hardware integrations and multi-branch inventory. Mobile apps and custom SaaS portals are scoped on milestone sprints. We provide an exact, itemized quotation within 48 hours with zero hidden fees.

items.question: How long does a typical project take from start to launch?
items.answer: A standard professional corporate website is typically delivered in 2 to 3 weeks. An e-commerce Shopify or WooCommerce store usually takes 2 to 4 weeks. Custom mobile apps and POS systems take between 4 to 8 weeks depending on screen count and hardware tests. We give you a strict milestone calendar and demo progress every single week.

items.question: Can we visit your office in Model Town, Lahore to discuss our project?
items.answer: Yes, absolutely! We love meeting our clients in person. Our office is located on Model Town Link Road, Lahore. You are welcome to visit Monday through Saturday between 9:00 AM and 6:00 PM. Please give us a quick call or WhatsApp message at 0315-4112925 so we can reserve a meeting room and have tea ready.

items.question: Who owns the code and intellectual property once the project is finished?
items.answer: You do — 100%. Upon project completion and final milestone clearance, we hand over the full GitHub source code repository, production database backups, design files, and cloud credentials. You have complete legal ownership to host, modify, or scale your software however you choose.

items.question: Do you train our staff on how to use our POS software or website dashboard?
items.answer: Yes. We include dedicated training sessions for you and your staff. For Lahore clients, we can do in-person training at your premises or our office. For remote clients, we conduct live screen-share sessions and provide step-by-step video recordings that you can reference anytime when onboarding new staff.

items.question: What happens after launch if something breaks or needs updates?
items.answer: Every project includes 60 days of complimentary post-launch warranty where we fix any unexpected bugs or glitches free of charge. After the warranty period, we offer flexible, affordable monthly maintenance packages to keep your servers patched, backups secure, and features updated.
